stops.note: to stand; present participle stans/stantis formed Vulgar Latin stantia, "place, abode"
from Vulgar Latin stantia; meant "resting place, harbor" (cf. the related but separate Italian stanza)
settled as the English word for a standing position, or a settled viewpoint
stops.meaning: a standing position, or a settled viewpoint

current_meaning: the way a person stands, or a settled opinion on an issue
